cache_freshness_review.reason: UpdateCacheFreshness.icers is an i64 field without serde(default) or serde(alias). Deriving Rust Default does not itself apply missing-field defaults during Deserialize. The parent UpdateCache.freshness field separately has serde(default), so complete absence yields a default freshness object, while an older present object with ice and no icers fails to deserialize. read_cache uses serde_json::from_str(...).ok(), so that failure yields None for the whole cache. The merge writer can start from unwrap_or_default; fallback from freshness.icers<=0 to aggregate checked_at remains present. The proposal correctly limits the consequence to reused/copied historical cache content and does not claim a real cache was examined, silently migrated or erased.

403 | pub(crate) fn validate_release_asset_url(
404 |     value: &str,
405 |     repository: &str,
406 |     tag: &str,
407 | ) -> Result<(), String> {
408 |     let url = reqwest::Url::parse(value).map_err(|_| "invalid archive URL")?;
409 |     let segments: Vec<String> = url
410 |         .path_segments()
411 |         .ok_or("archive URL has no path")?
412 |         .map(|s| {
413 |             percent_encoding::percent_decode_str(s)
414 |                 .decode_utf8()
415 |                 .map(|s| s.into_owned())
416 |                 .map_err(|_| "invalid encoded archive URL")
417 |         })
418 |         .collect::<Result<_, _>>()?;
419 |     if url.scheme() != "https"
420 |         || url.host_str() != Some("github.com")
421 |         || url.port().is_some()
422 |         || !url.username().is_empty()
423 |         || url.password().is_some()
424 |         || url.query().is_some()
425 |         || url.fragment().is_some()
426 |         || segments.len() != 6
427 |         || segments[2] != "releases"
428 |         || segments[3] != "download"
429 |         || segments[4] != tag
430 |         || canonical_repository(&format!(
431 |             "https://github.com/{}/{}",
432 |             segments[0], segments[1]
433 |         ))? != repository
434 |         || segments[5].is_empty()
435 |         || matches!(segments[5].as_str(), "." | "..")
436 |         || !segments[5]
437 |             .bytes()
438 |             .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(b, b'-' | b'_' | b'.' | b'+'))
439 |     {
440 |         return Err(
441 |             "archive URL must belong to the same GitHub repository and package Release".into(),
442 |         );
443 |     }
444 |     Ok(())
